Proof. Pick \(a_{0}\) with \(w(a_{0}) > 0\). Since \((\bd w)(t(a_{0})) = 0\) and the arrow \(a_{0}\) contributes positively to that sum, some arrow \(a_{1}\) with \(s(a_{1}) = t(a_{0})\) has \(w(a_{1}) > 0\). Repeating, we obtain an infinite walk inside \(\supp (w)\), which is finite, so some vertex repeats and the walk contains a directed cycle. □
